notes.title: Release Date and Price Announcement for “Brave × Junction”!
notes.content: [p]The release date for the Blackjack RPG “Brave × Junction” has been set![/p][p]The PlayStation version will launch on [b]Wednesday, October 8, 2025[/b], while the Steam and Nintendo Switch versions are scheduled for release on [b]Thursday, October 9[/b]![/p][p]The price is [b]10.99＄[/b].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="spNB_XaT5Zw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Official Homepage　[url="https://www.rideongames.com/bravejunction/"]https://www.rideongames.com/bravejunction/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Blackjack RPG Brave × Junction to be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show!
notes.content: [p]We are pleased to announce that we will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Show 2025 (TGS2025), which will be held at Makuhari Messe from Thursday, September 25th to Sunday, September 28th, 2025. [/p][p][/p][p] We have also launched an official website introducing the story, game system, characters, and more of "Brave × Junction." A promotional video for "Brave × Junction" has also been released on the Ride On Japan official YouTube channel.  [/p][p][/p][p]Official website: https://www.rideongames.com/bravejunction/ [/p][p]Promotional video: https://youtu.be/spNB_XaT5Zw?si=g4GTRHpM57LPIeh1[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600298/5cfab0dec69f5f745da0ba52763769ca4abc6afd.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Notice of Exhibit at Tokyo Game Dungeon 9!
notes.content: [p]We will be exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 9, an indie game exhibition to be held at the Tokyo Metropolitan Industrial Trade Center on Sunday, August 3![/p][p]At the event, we plan to try out the trial version of “Brave × Junction” and distribute original novelty goods.[/p][p]Please wait for further information on the details of the novelty goods![/p][p]The location of RideOn Japan's booth is “4K-3” on the 4th floor.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600298/f0fbe06672b1b54e9a347d73f7e03d6a924421f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Official website: [url="https://tokyogamedungeon.com/"]https://tokyogamedungeon.com/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version Update Notice
notes.content: [p]Thank you for trying out the demo version and for completing the questionnaire![/p][p]We've updated the demo version with the following improvements:[/p][p][/p][p]- Redesigned key assignment for changing expressions in the status menu[/p][p]- Added cursor movement settings for AZERTY keyboards[/p][p]- Adjusted the volume levels of certain sound effects and voice lines[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue enhancing the experience for future releases—stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Brave×Junction Demo Version Questionnaire now underway!
notes.content: [p]"Brave × Junction" is currently under development. We will collect feedback from the trial version and continue development to complete a high-quality game.[/p][p][/p][p]Please let us know your thoughts![/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfQNYQg4z0PcWtmXj3nIeK0cgKe297-M-aFvd8DIYmcJZo2Uw/viewform?pli=1"]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfQNYQg4z0PcWtmXj3nIeK0cgKe297-M-aFvd8DIYmcJZo2Uw/viewform?pli=1[/url][/p]

notes.title: Brave × Junction Gameplay streaming video
notes.content: [p]We will be broadcasting videos from Shirokori Games' YouTube stream archive, where users can play "Brave × Junction," on the storefront during the SteamNext fest.[/p]
